DexHall_Text_NoRoom.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la\nplace, puis reviens.
DexHall_Text_NoRoom.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.

DexHall_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

DexHall_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
DexHall_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
